build_ltx2_attention: build an LTX2Attention module with configurable heads, dim_head, RoPE type, and gated attention
create_rotary_embeddings_1d: create 1D rotary positional embeddings with interleaved or split RoPE type for sequence modeling
build_transformer_block_1d: build a 1D transformer block with self-attention, RMSNorm, and FeedForward layers
build_connector_transformer_1d: build a 1D sequence transformer with learnable registers, RoPE embeddings, and gradient checkpointing
run_text_connectors: run LTX2TextConnectors to process text encoder hidden states into separate video and audio embeddings
